标题: GREClue: Failure Indexing with Graph-based Failure Representation and Entropy-based Deep Clustering
标题翻译: GREClue：基于图失效表示与熵驱动深度聚类的失效索引
作者列表: Zhenyu Yang, Zhongxing Yu（通讯）
单位: Zhenyu Yang (Shandong University); Zhongxing Yu（通讯） (Shandong University, China)
摘要: Failure indexing aims to group multiple failures according to their root causes and is an essential step in parallel debugging. Failure indexing consists mainly of two steps: failure representation and failure clustering. While many research efforts have been devoted to these two steps, serious issues still exist. For failure representation, existing works use coverage or program memory information, which unfortunately can not capture deep failure semantic. For failure clustering, advanced failure indexing methods use clustering algorithms with preset cluster centers, but this kind of clustering algorithm can handle spherical clusters well but performs poorly when handling clusters of other shapes. To address these issues, this paper proposes GREClue, a novel failure indexing approach with Graph-based failure Representation and Entropy-based deep Clustering. GREClue overcomes the issues in order. For failure representation, GREClue designs the failure semantic graph (FSG), a new graph representation that effectively contains semantic information and runtime information of failures. Based on FSG, GREClue further consists of an entropy-based deep clustering component, which can accurately cluster failed tests without presetting cluster centers. An extensive evaluation of GREClue shows that compared to the state-of-the-art failure indexing method, GREClue improves both the performance of estimating the number of faults and the clustering effectiveness by 10% to 41%. Moreover, it has also been shown that GREClue can effectively facilitate parallel debugging.
摘要翻译: 失效索引旨在按根因对多个失效分组，是并行调试的关键步骤，主要包括失效表示与失效聚类两步。尽管已有大量研究，仍存在严重问题：失效表示方面，现有工作使用覆盖或程序内存信息，无法捕获深层失效语义；失效聚类方面，先进方法使用带预设聚类中心的算法，这类算法处理球状簇良好，但面对其他形状的簇表现不佳。为解决这些问题，本文提出GREClue——基于图失效表示与熵驱动深度聚类的新颖失效索引方法。GREClue逐一克服上述问题：设计失效语义图（FSG）这一有效包含失效语义与运行时信息的新图表示；基于FSG进一步构建熵驱动深度聚类组件，无需预设聚类中心即可精准聚类失败测试。大量评估表明，与最先进的失效索引方法相比，GREClue将故障数估计与聚类效果提升10%至41%，且能有效促进并行调试。
问题挑战: 并行调试中的失效索引需按根因分组失效，但现有失效表示基于覆盖或内存信息难以捕获深层失效语义，且带预设聚类中心的算法对非球状簇效果差。
核心方法: 提出GREClue，设计融合语义与运行时信息的失效语义图（FSG）表示失效，并采用无需预设聚类中心的熵驱动深度聚类方法对失败测试聚类。
主要效果: 与最先进失效索引方法相比，故障数估计与聚类效果提升10%~41%，并能有效促进并行调试。
一句话总结: 针对失效索引语义表示不足与簇形假设受限的问题，研究图失效表示与熵驱动深度聚类技术，实现索引性能10%~41%的提升。
关键词: 失效索引；调试；图表示学习；深度聚类；并行调试

标题: GraphLocator: Graph-guided Causal Reasoning for Issue Localization
标题翻译: GraphLocator：图引导因果推理的Issue定位
作者列表: Wei Liu, Chao Peng（通讯）, Pengfei Gao, Aofan Liu, Wei Zhang（通讯）, Haiyan Zhao, Zhi Jin（通讯）
单位: Wei Liu (Peking University); Chao Peng（通讯） (Tencent, China); Pengfei Gao (ByteDance); Aofan Liu (Peking University); Wei Zhang（通讯） (Peking University, China); Haiyan Zhao (Peking University, China); Zhi Jin（通讯） (Peking University, Wuhan University, China)
摘要: The issue localization task aims to identify the locations in a software repository that requires modification given a natural language issue description. This task is fundamental yet challenging in automated software engineering due to the semantic gap between issue description and source code implementation. This gap manifests as two mismatches: (1) \emph{symptom–to-cause mismatches}, where descriptions do not explicitly reveal underlying root causes; (2) \emph{one-to-many mismatches}, where a single issue corresponds to multiple interdependent code entities. To address these two mismatches, we propose \emph{GraphLocator}, an LLM-based approach that mitigates symptom–to-cause mismatches through \emph{causal structure discovering} and resolves one-to-many mismatches via \emph{dynamic issue disentangling}. The key artifact of \emph{GraphLocator} is the \emph{causal issue graph} (CIG), in which vertices represent discovered sub-issues along with their associated code entities, and edges encode the causal dependencies between them. The workflow of \emph{GraphLocator} consists of two phases: \emph{symptom vertices locating} and \emph{dynamic CIG discovering}; it first identifies symptom locations on the repository graph, then dynamically expands the CIG by iteratively reasoning over neighboring vertices, discovering new sub-issues and updating causal dependencies. Experiments on three real-world Python and Java datasets demonstrates the effectiveness of \emph{GraphLocator}: (1) Compared with baselines, \emph{GraphLocator} achieves more accurate localization with average improvements of +19.49% in function-level recall and +11.89% in precision with acceptable overhead. (2) \emph{GraphLocator} outperforms baselines on both symptom-to-cause and one-to-many mismatch scenarios, achieving recall improvement of +16.44% and +19.18%, precision improvement of +7.78% and +13.23%, respectively. (3) The disentangled causal structure CIG generated by \emph{GraphLocator} yields the highest relative improvement, resulting in a 28.74% increase in performance on the downstream issue-resolving task.
摘要翻译: issue定位任务旨在根据自然语言issue描述识别软件仓库中需要修改的位置。由于issue描述与源代码实现之间存在语义鸿沟，该任务是自动化软件工程中基础而充满挑战的一环。这一鸿沟表现为两类错配：（1）症状-根因错配，即描述未显式揭示底层根因；（2）一对多错配，即单一issue对应多个相互依赖的代码实体。为解决这两类错配，我们提出基于LLM的方法GraphLocator，通过因果结构发现缓解症状-根因错配，通过动态issue解耦化解一对多错配。GraphLocator的关键产物是因果issue图（CIG）：顶点表示发现的子issue及其关联代码实体，边编码其间的因果依赖。GraphLocator的工作流分两阶段：症状顶点定位与动态CIG发现；它先在仓库图上定位症状位置，再通过迭代推理邻近顶点动态扩展CIG，发现新子issue并更新因果依赖。在三个真实Python与Java数据集上的实验证明了GraphLocator的有效性：（1）与基线相比，GraphLocator实现更准确的定位，函数级召回率平均提升19.49%、精确率提升11.89%，且开销可接受；（2）GraphLocator在症状-根因与一对多错配场景上均优于基线，召回率分别提升16.44%与19.18%，精确率分别提升7.78%与13.23%；（3）GraphLocator生成的解耦因果结构CIG带来最高相对提升，使下游issue解决任务性能提升28.74%。
问题挑战: issue定位需根据自然语言描述找到仓库中待修改位置，但描述与实现间存在症状-根因错配与一对多错配（单一issue对应多个相互依赖代码实体）两大语义鸿沟。
核心方法: 提出基于LLM的GraphLocator，通过因果结构发现缓解症状-根因错配、动态issue解耦化解一对多错配，在仓库图上先定位症状顶点再迭代扩展因果issue图（CIG）发现子issue与因果依赖。
主要效果: 在三个真实Python与Java数据集上函数级召回率与精确率平均提升19.49%与11.89%，两类错配场景均显著优于基线，CIG结构使下游issue解决任务提升28.74%。
一句话总结: 针对issue定位中症状根因与一对多语义错配的问题，研究因果图构建与动态解耦技术，实现定位召回率与精确率两位数提升并促进下游修复任务。
关键词: 缺陷定位；因果推理；大语言模型；图谱推理；仓库级理解

分类: 三、缺陷定位、调试与自动修复
标题: Empowering Autonomous Debugging Agents with Efficient Dynamic Analysis
标题翻译: 以高效动态分析赋能自主调试智能体
作者列表: Jiahong Xiang, Xiaoyang Xu, Xiaopan Chu, Hongliang Tian, Yuqun Zhang（通讯）
单位: Jiahong Xiang (Southern University of Science and Technology); Xiaoyang Xu (Southern University of Science and Technology); Xiaopan Chu (Southern University of Science and Technology); Hongliang Tian (Ant Group); Yuqun Zhang（通讯） (Southern University of Science and Technology, China)
摘要: Autonomous agents for automated program repair represent a promising frontier in software engineering, yet their effectiveness is often hindered by reliance on post-mortem, coarse-grained execution feedback. While integrating traditional interactive debuggers seems a natural solution, their low-level, line-by-line interaction paradigm turns to be cost-inefficient for LLM-based agents, leading to exhausted budgets and unproductive loops. To mitigate this, we introduce Agent-centric Debugging Interface (ADI), a novel agent-centric debugging interface designed for cost-efficient, end-to-end autonomous interaction. Specifically, Agent-centric Debugging Interface realizes a function-level interaction paradigm, powered by our Frame Lifetime Trace—a comprehensive data structure encapsulating a function’s stateful execution trace—and a set of high-level navigational commands. Our extensive evaluation on the SWE-bench benchmark demonstrates the effectiveness and efficiency of ADI. By simply equipping a basic agent with ADI, it successfully resolves 63.8% of the tasks on the SWE-bench Verified set, even slightly outperforming the highly-optimized and high-investment Claude-Tools agent, at an average cost of $1.28 per task with Claude-Sonnet-3.7. Furthermore, we demonstrate ADI’s generality by integrating it as a plug-and-play component into the existing SOTA agents, delivering consistent gains ranging from 6.2% to 18.5% on the resolved tasks. These results indicate that Agent-centric Debugging Interface could achieve a general and efficient enhancement for the existing autonomous agents.
摘要翻译: 面向自动程序修复的自主智能体是软件工程中富有前景的前沿方向，但其效果常受限于对事后、粗粒度执行反馈的依赖。集成传统交互式调试器似乎是自然的解决方案，但其低层的逐行交互范式对基于LLM的智能体成本高昂，导致预算耗尽与无效循环。为缓解此问题，我们提出面向智能体的调试接口ADI（Agent-centric Debugging Interface），专为高性价比的端到端自主交互设计。具体而言，ADI通过帧生命周期轨迹（Frame Lifetime Trace，封装函数有状态执行轨迹的全面数据结构）与一组高层导航命令实现函数级交互范式。我们在SWE-bench基准上的广泛评估证明了ADI的有效性与高效性。仅为一个基础智能体配备ADI，即能在SWE-bench Verified上解决63.8%的任务，甚至略优于高度优化、高投入的Claude-Tools智能体，使用Claude-Sonnet-3.7时平均每任务成本仅1.28美元。此外，我们将ADI作为即插即用组件集成到现有SOTA智能体中，在已解决任务上带来6.2%至18.5%的一致提升，证明了ADI的普适性。这些结果表明，ADI可对现有自主智能体实现通用而高效的增强。
问题挑战: 自动程序修复智能体依赖事后、粗粒度的执行反馈，而传统交互式调试器的逐行低层交互范式对LLM智能体成本过高，易耗尽预算并陷入无效循环。
核心方法: 提出以智能体为中心的调试接口ADI，基于封装函数级有状态执行轨迹的帧生命周期轨迹数据结构与高层导航命令，实现高性价比的函数级端到端自主交互。
主要效果: 基础智能体配备ADI即在SWE-bench Verified上解决63.8%的任务（平均每任务1.28美元），作为即插即用组件为现有SOTA智能体带来6.2%~18.5%的一致提升。
一句话总结: 针对调试智能体动态分析反馈粗粒度且成本高的问题，研究函数级调试接口技术，实现SWE-bench解决率63.8%并对SOTA智能体持续增益。
关键词: 自主智能体；程序修复；动态分析；调试接口；SWE-bench

标题: Debugging Engine Enhanced by Prior Knowledge: Can We Teach LLM How to Debug?
标题翻译: 先验知识增强的调试引擎：我们能教会大语言模型如何调试吗？
作者列表: Kunyi Li, Sai Wu, Xiu Tang（通讯）, Chang Yao, Songhao Bu, Quanqing Xu, Gang Chen
单位: Kunyi Li (Zhejiang University, China, China); Sai Wu (Zhejiang University); Xiu Tang（通讯） (Zhejiang University); Chang Yao (Zhejiang University); Songhao Bu (Zhejiang University); Quanqing Xu (OceanBase, Ant Group); Gang Chen (Zhejiang University)
摘要: Automated Program Repair (APR) powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) has shown strong potential for improving software reliability. However, existing LLM-based APR approaches underutilize the rich debugging knowledge latent in large-scale bug-fix corpora. Prior work has primarily advanced APR through multi-agent coordination, prompt engineering, task decomposition, or model training. While effective to some extent, these methods rely heavily on the implicit reasoning capacity of LLMs, without explicitly modeling the debugging knowledge that underlies successful program repair. We present DeepK, a novel framework that systematically extracts, validates, and reuses debugging knowledge to guide LLMs in APR. Rather than treating historical bug-fix pairs solely as contextual exemplars, DeepK distills them into a structured knowledge base of verified debugging knowledge. This knowledge base can be seamlessly integrated into diverse APR pipelines, providing interpretable reasoning traces and step-wise repair strategies that enhance the repair performance. We evaluate DeepK on multiple benchmarks (ACPR, Atcoder) using both GPT-4o and DeepSeek-v3. Results show that DeepK consistently surpasses state-of-the-art APR systems in repair accuracy. Ablation studies confirm the importance of edit description generation, multi-perspective retrieval, and two-fold debugging knowledge. Varying the number of retrieved entries further highlights the trade-off between informativeness and noise. These findings emphasize the essential contribution of explicit debugging knowledge in advancing LLM-based APR and establish DeepK as an extensible framework for building more reliable repair systems.
摘要翻译: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的自动程序修复（APR）在提升软件可靠性方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有基于LLM的APR方法未能充分利用大规模缺陷修复语料中潜藏的丰富调试知识。先前工作主要通过多智能体协作、提示工程、任务分解或模型训练推进APR，虽在一定程度上有效，但它们高度依赖LLM的隐式推理能力，未对成功程序修复背后的调试知识进行显式建模。我们提出新框架DeepK，系统性地提取、验证并复用调试知识以指导LLM进行程序修复。DeepK不再将历史缺陷-修复对仅视为上下文示例，而是将其蒸馏为经验证调试知识的结构化知识库。该知识库可无缝集成到多种APR流水线中，提供可解释的推理轨迹与分步修复策略以增强修复性能。我们在ACPR、Atcoder等多个基准上使用GPT-4o与DeepSeek-v3评估DeepK。结果表明，DeepK的修复准确率持续超越最先进的APR系统。消融实验证实了编辑描述生成、多视角检索与双重调试知识的重要性。改变检索条目数进一步揭示了信息量与噪声之间的权衡。这些发现凸显了显式调试知识对推进基于LLM的APR的关键贡献，并使DeepK成为构建更可靠修复系统的可扩展框架。
问题挑战: 现有基于LLM的自动程序修复方法依赖模型的隐式推理能力，未显式建模大规模缺陷修复语料中蕴含的调试知识，导致修复性能受限。
核心方法: 提出DeepK框架，从历史缺陷-修复对中系统性地提取并验证调试知识、构建结构化知识库，通过多视角检索复用知识以指导LLM进行程序修复。
主要效果: 在ACPR、Atcoder等基准上配合GPT-4o与DeepSeek-v3，DeepK的修复准确率持续超越最先进的APR系统，消融实验验证了各组件的必要性。
一句话总结: 针对LLM自动程序修复中调试知识利用不足的问题，研究调试知识的提取、验证与复用技术，实现持续超越现有最先进方法的修复准确率。
关键词: 自动程序修复；大语言模型；调试知识；知识库；缺陷修复

标题: ExpeRepair: Dual-Memory Enhanced LLM-based Repository-Level Program Repair
标题翻译: ExpeRepair：双记忆增强的基于LLM的仓库级程序修复
作者列表: Fangwen Mu, Junjie Wang, Lin Shi, Song Wang, Shoubin Li, Qing Wang（通讯）
单位: Fangwen Mu (Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences); Junjie Wang (Institute of Software at Chinese Academy of Sciences, China); Lin Shi (Beihang University); Song Wang (York University, Canada); Shoubin Li (Institute of Software at Chinese Academy of Sciences, China); Qing Wang（通讯） (Institute of Software at Chinese Academy of Sciences, China)
摘要: Automatically repairing software issues remains a fundamental challenge at the intersection of software engineering and AI. Although recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential for repository-level repair tasks, current methodologies exhibit two notable limitations: (1) they often address issues in isolation, neglecting to incorporate insights from previously resolved issues, and (2) they rely on static, rigid prompting strategies that constrain their ability to generalize across diverse and evolving issue scenarios. We propose ExpeRepair, a novel LLM-based program repair framework inspired by the dual memory systems of human cognition, where episodic and semantic memory synergistically support learning and decision-making. Unlike existing methods, ExpeRepair continuously learns from historical repair experiences via dual-channel knowledge accumulation, enabling it to adaptively reuse past knowledge during inference. Specifically, ExpeRepair organizes prior repair knowledge into two complementary memories: an episodic memory that stores concrete repair demonstrations, and a semantic memory that encodes abstract, reflective insights. At inference time, ExpeRepair activates both memory systems by retrieving relevant demonstrations from episodic memory and recalling high-level repair insights from semantic memory. It further enhances adaptability through dynamic prompt composition, synergistically integrating both memory types to replace static prompts with context-aware, experience-driven prompts. We evaluate ExpeRepair on two benchmarks: SWE-Bench Lite and SWE-Bench Verified. Experimental results show that ExpeRepair achieves Pass@1 scores of 60.3% and 74.6% on the two benchmarks, respectively, establishing new state-of-the-art performance among open-source methods. We have open-sourced ExpeRepair at https://github.com/ExpeRepair/ExpeRepair.
摘要翻译: 自动修复软件问题仍是软件工程与人工智能交叉领域的基础挑战。尽管大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展已展现出仓库级修复任务的潜力，但现有方法存在两个显著局限：（1）孤立处理各个问题，未吸纳已解决问题的经验洞见；（2）依赖静态僵化的提示策略，限制了在多样演化问题场景中的泛化能力。我们提出ExpeRepair——受人类认知双记忆系统启发的新颖LLM程序修复框架，情景记忆与语义记忆协同支持学习与决策。与现有方法不同，ExpeRepair通过双通道知识积累持续从历史修复经验中学习，使推理时能够自适应复用过往知识。具体而言，ExpeRepair将先验修复知识组织为两种互补记忆：存储具体修复示范的情景记忆与编码抽象反思洞见的语义记忆。推理时，ExpeRepair激活两种记忆系统，从情景记忆检索相关示范并从语义记忆回忆高层修复洞见。它还通过动态提示组合增强适应性，协同整合两种记忆，以上下文感知、经验驱动的提示替代静态提示。我们在SWE-Bench Lite与SWE-Bench Verified两个基准上评估ExpeRepair。实验结果表明，ExpeRepair在两个基准上分别取得60.3%与74.6%的Pass@1，在开源方法中确立新的最先进性能。我们已开源ExpeRepair。
问题挑战: 现有LLM仓库级程序修复方法孤立处理各个问题、不借鉴历史修复经验，且依赖静态僵化的提示策略，难以泛化到多样演化的问题场景。
核心方法: 受人类双记忆系统启发提出ExpeRepair，将历史修复知识组织为情景记忆（具体修复示范）与语义记忆（抽象反思洞见），推理时双通道检索并以动态提示组合替代静态提示。
主要效果: 在SWE-Bench Lite与SWE-Bench Verified上分别取得60.3%与74.6%的Pass@1，在开源方法中确立新的最先进性能。
一句话总结: 针对LLM修复缺乏经验积累与提示僵化的问题，研究情景-语义双记忆与动态提示组合技术，实现开源方法中SOTA的仓库级修复性能。
关键词: 程序修复；大语言模型；双记忆机制；仓库级修复；SWE-bench

标题: GPU-Accelerated Flow-Sensitive Pointer Analysis for C/C++ Programs
标题翻译: 面向C/C++程序的GPU加速流敏感指针分析
作者列表: Jiaqi He, Karim Ali
单位: Jiaqi He (University of Alberta, Canada); Karim Ali (NYU Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates)
摘要: Flow-sensitive pointer analysis offers highly precise results that are essential for various security analyses, bug detection tools, and compiler optimizations. However, its high computational cost often leads to prohibitively long analysis times, especially for large, real-world programs. Despite decades of research, state-of-the-art algorithms still struggle to achieve acceptable performance at industrial scale, forcing developers to choose less precise alternatives. To overcome these limitations, we present GPA a GPU-accelerated flow-sensitive pointer analysis for C/C++ programs. To maximize hardware utilization, GPA dynamically balances computation by combining the massive parallelism of GPUs with a graph neural network that predicts per-variable workloads. Compared to state-of-the-art CPU-based analyses, GPA improves runtime performance by a factor of $1.3\times$ to $14\times$ on large programs (i.e., ≥275~KLOC) without sacrificing precision. However, on most small programs (i.e., <100~KLOC) and some medium ones (i.e., 100–275~KLOC), traditional algorithms run faster due to the overhead of memory management on GPUs that GPA incurs. By making the computation of highly precise pointer information more tractable, GPA enables running analyses and developer tools that were previously infeasible on large codebases.
摘要翻译: 流敏感指针分析可提供高精度结果，对各类安全分析、缺陷检测工具与编译器优化至关重要。然而其高计算成本常导致过长的分析时间，对大型真实程序尤甚。尽管已有数十年研究，最先进算法在工业规模上仍难以达到可接受性能，迫使开发者选择精度较低的替代方案。为克服这些限制，我们提出面向C/C++程序的GPU加速流敏感指针分析GPA。为最大化硬件利用率，GPA将GPU大规模并行与预测逐变量负载的图神经网络相结合，动态均衡计算。与最先进的CPU分析相比，GPA在大型程序（即不少于27.5万行）上提速1.3至14倍且不损失精度。但在多数小程序（少于10万行）与部分中等程序（10万至27.5万行）上，由于GPU内存管理开销，传统算法运行更快。通过使高精度指针信息的计算更可行，GPA使以前在大型代码库上不可行的分析与开发者工具成为可能。
问题挑战: 流敏感指针分析精度高但计算开销大，最先进算法在工业规模程序上分析时间过长、难以接受，开发者被迫选择精度较低的替代方案。
核心方法: 提出GPU加速的流敏感指针分析GPA，将GPU大规模并行与预测逐变量工作负载的图神经网络结合，动态均衡计算以最大化硬件利用率。
主要效果: 在大型程序（27.5万行以上）上比SOTA的CPU分析提速1.3~14倍且精度无损；小程序上因GPU内存管理开销传统算法更快。
一句话总结: 针对流敏感指针分析工业规模不可行的问题，研究GPU并行与负载预测均衡技术，实现大程序1.3~14倍分析加速且精度无损。
关键词: 指针分析；流敏感分析；GPU加速；图神经网络；程序分析

分类: 四、程序分析与智能运维
标题: JavaScript Pointer Analysis with Adaptive Heap Abstraction
标题翻译: 采用自适应堆抽象的JavaScript指针分析
作者列表: Wenyuan Xu, Anders Møller
单位: Wenyuan Xu (Aarhus University); Anders Møller (Aarhus University, Denmark)
摘要: The conventional approach to represent objects in static program analysis is to use allocation-site abstraction. This design choice may lead to redundant computations when many abstract objects are similar. Existing mechanisms that aim to merge such objects are not effective for JavaScript. We propose a novel adaptive heap abstraction technique that during analysis discovers and merges similar abstract objects, thereby reducing the analysis complexity while preserving most of the precision. The technique has been implemented in a state-of-the-art program analyzer for JavaScript. On a collection of 96 challenging programs, it yields a 2X speedup on average (up to 17X) with a negligible loss of precision. The experimental results also show the effects of various analysis configurations.
摘要翻译: 静态程序分析中表示对象的传统做法是使用分配点抽象。当许多抽象对象相似时，这一设计选择可能导致冗余计算。旨在合并此类对象的现有机制对JavaScript效果不佳。我们提出新颖的自适应堆抽象技术，在分析过程中发现并合并相似的抽象对象，从而在保持大部分精度的同时降低分析复杂度。该技术已在最先进的JavaScript程序分析器中实现。在包含96个高难度程序的集合上，平均提速2倍（最高17倍），精度损失可忽略。实验结果还展示了各种分析配置的影响。
问题挑战: 静态分析以分配点抽象表示对象，当大量抽象对象相似时产生冗余计算，而既有的对象合并机制对JavaScript效果不佳，流敏感指针分析开销居高不下。
核心方法: 提出在分析过程中自适应发现并合并相似抽象对象的自适应堆抽象技术，在保持绝大多数精度的同时降低分析复杂度，并实现在最先进的JavaScript分析器中。
主要效果: 在96个高难度程序上平均提速2倍（最高17倍），精度损失可忽略。
一句话总结: 针对JavaScript指针分析对象冗余导致开销大的问题，研究自适应堆抽象合并技术，实现平均2倍、最高17倍的加速且精度近无损。
关键词: 指针分析；JavaScript；自适应堆抽象；静态分析；程序分析
作者团队简介: PDF首页未标注通讯作者。论文由丹麦奥胡斯大学Anders Møller教授（TAJS分析器与《Static Program Analysis》教材作者、静态分析权威）的编程语言与软件组产出：一作Wenyuan Xu为其博士生，本文属其JavaScript安全静态分析博士课题的核心成果。

标题: GAER: Graph Auto-Encoders for Unsupervised Software Architecture Recovery
标题翻译: GAER：基于图自编码器的无监督软件架构恢复
作者列表: Rakhshanda Jabeen, Morgan Ericsson, Jonas Nordqvist, Anna Wingkvist
单位: Rakhshanda Jabeen (Electrolux Professional); Morgan Ericsson (Linnaeus University, Sweden); Jonas Nordqvist (Linnaeus University); Anna Wingkvist (Linnaeus University, Sweden)
摘要: Recovering the modular architecture of software systems from source code is a longstanding challenge, especially when documentation is incomplete or outdated. Manual recovery is labor-intensive, error-prone, and does not scale to large systems. While automated approaches have been proposed, many rely on handcrafted heuristics or focus narrowly on either structural or semantic information, which limits their ability to capture the full range of architectural signals. We introduce GAER, an unsupervised architecture recovery approach based on graph auto-encoders (GAEs) that frames architecture recovery as a representation learning problem. Software systems are modeled as heterogeneous graphs with typed dependencies, while folder hierarchies and code semantics are incorporated as node features. We evaluate two encoder variants, GAT and GCN, and find that GAT generally yields more accurate and stable decompositions. Experiments on ten open-source systems with ground-truth architectures show that GAER improves recovery accuracy by about 30% on average across evaluation metrics compared to a state-of-the-art method. By automatically deriving architectural views that integrate multiple signals, GAER reduces the manual effort required to maintain architectural documentation and supports more effective system understanding.
摘要翻译: 从源代码恢复软件系统的模块化架构是长期挑战，尤其在文档不完整或过时的情况下。人工恢复费时、易错且无法扩展到大型系统。虽已有自动化方法提出，但许多依赖人工启发式或狭隘聚焦于结构或语义单一信息，限制了其捕获全谱架构信号的能力。我们提出GAER——基于图自编码器（GAE）的无监督架构恢复方法，将架构恢复形式化为表示学习问题。软件系统被建模为带类型依赖的异构图，文件夹层次与代码语义作为节点特征融入。我们评估GAT与GCN两种编码器变体，发现GAT通常产生更准确稳定的分解。在十个具有真实架构基准的开源系统上的实验表明，与最先进方法相比，GAER在各评估指标上平均提升约30%的恢复准确率。通过自动派生整合多种信号的架构视图，GAER减少了维护架构文档的人工投入，支持更有效的系统理解。
问题挑战: 从源代码恢复软件模块化架构是长期挑战，人工恢复费力易错且不可扩展，现有自动化方法依赖人工启发式或仅关注结构/语义单一信息，难以捕获全谱架构信号。
核心方法: 提出将架构恢复形式化为表示学习问题的GAER方法，把软件系统建模为带类型依赖的异构图，以文件夹层次与代码语义为节点特征，经图自编码器（GAT/GCN编码器）无监督学习架构分解。
主要效果: 在十个具有真实架构基准的开源系统上，恢复准确率相较SOTA方法平均提升约30%，GAT编码器分解更准确稳定。
一句话总结: 针对软件架构恢复人工成本高的问题，研究异构图自编码表示学习技术，实现架构恢复准确率平均约30%的提升。

标题: Improving Data Leakage Detection in Machine Learning Notebooks through Static Slicing and Structured LLM Prompts
标题翻译: 结合静态切片与结构化LLM提示改进机器学习Notebook数据泄漏检测
作者列表: Taha Draoui, Mohamed Wiem Mkaouer, Christian D. Newman
单位: Taha Draoui (University of Michigan-Flint); Mohamed Wiem Mkaouer (University of Michigan-Flint, United States); Christian D. Newman (Rochester Institute of Technology)
摘要: Data leakage remains a critical yet under-diagnosed issue in machine learning pipelines, leading to inflated results and unreliable deployments. Existing detection approaches rely on static rules that often miss open-coded manipulations and fail to capture the diversity of real-world notebooks. This paper introduces a novel methodology that integrates static slicing with large language models (LLMs) to improve leakage detection. We use a Datalog-based static analysis that isolates compact, provenance-aware slices corresponding to model training and evaluation pairs, and we pair these with structured LLM prompts that guide step-by-step reasoning about potential leakage for each isolated slice. Evaluated on a curated benchmark of Python notebooks from Kaggle and GitHub, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance in both preprocessing and overlap leakage detection, substantially outperforming end-to-end prompting and the rule-based baseline. Our findings highlight the effectiveness of combining program slicing and prompt engineering for data leakage detection and establish the first systematic LLM-based solution for detecting data leakage in machine learning code.
摘要翻译: 数据泄漏仍是机器学习流水线中关键却诊断不足的问题，会导致虚高的结果与不可靠的部署。现有检测方法依赖静态规则，常遗漏开放编码的操作，无法覆盖真实Notebook的多样性。本文提出将静态切片与大语言模型（LLM）相结合以改进泄漏检测的新方法。我们使用基于Datalog的静态分析，隔离出与模型训练-评估对相应的紧凑、感知来源的切片，并将其与结构化LLM提示配对，引导对每个被隔离切片潜在泄漏的逐步推理。在来自Kaggle与GitHub的Python Notebook精选基准上的评估表明，我们的方法在预处理与重叠型泄漏检测上均取得最先进性能，大幅优于端到端提示与规则基线。我们的发现凸显了程序切片与提示工程结合用于数据泄漏检测的有效性，并确立了首个系统性的基于LLM的机器学习代码数据泄漏检测方案。
问题挑战: 数据泄漏是机器学习流水线中易被漏诊的关键问题，会导致虚高结果与不可靠部署，而现有静态规则方法难以捕捉开放编码操作与真实Notebook的多样性。
核心方法: 提出将基于Datalog的静态切片与结构化LLM提示相结合的方法：切片隔离出与训练-评估对相关的紧凑溯源切片，结构化提示引导LLM对每个切片逐步推理潜在泄漏。
主要效果: 在Kaggle与GitHub的Python Notebook基准上，预处理与重叠型泄漏检测均取得最先进性能，大幅优于端到端提示与规则基线，为首个系统性LLM泄漏检测方案。
一句话总结: 针对机器学习Notebook数据泄漏难检测的问题，研究静态切片与结构化提示融合技术，实现泄漏检测性能达到SOTA。
关键词: 数据泄漏；机器学习；静态切片；大语言模型；Notebook分析

标题: EventADL: Open-Box Anomaly Detection and Localization Framework for Events in Cloud-Based Service Systems
标题翻译: EventADL：面向云服务系统事件的白盒式异常检测与定位框架
作者列表: Luan Pham, Victor Nicolet, Joey Dodds, Hui Guan, Daniel Kroening
单位: Luan Pham (University of New South Wales, Australia, Australia); Victor Nicolet (Amazon, Canada); Joey Dodds (Amazon, Inc.); Hui Guan (Amazon Web Services, USA, United States); Daniel Kroening (Amazon, United States)
摘要: Anomaly detection and localization (ADL) is critical for maintaining high reliability and availability in cloud-based systems. Recent ADL developments focus on metric and log data, leaving event data relatively unexplored. To address this gap, we propose EventADL, the first open-box ADL framework for events in cloud-based service systems. To motivate the design of our framework, we conduct a systematic analysis on 520 real-world incidents, and provide several important insights into how anomalies and their root causes manifest through event data. The EventADL framework has three phases: offline training, online anomaly detection, and anomaly localization. During the training phase, EventADL learns Event Semantic Patterns (ESPs) for pointwise anomaly detection and Event Frequency Patterns (EFPs) for frequency-based anomaly detection using unlabelled historical data. In the online anomaly detection phase, any data in the event stream that deviates significantly from these patterns is identified as anomalous. In the localization phase, EventADL constructs an Intervention Graph that models the relationships between recent interventions (i.e., system changes visible through events) and the detected anomalies for automatic root cause localization. The framework is designed to operate efficiently without labeled data , and to produce interpretable results. Our evaluation on three real cloud-based service systems and two real-world incidents, compared against ten state-of-the-art baselines, demonstrates that EventADL outperforms existing methods, achieving F1-scores of at least 90% for anomaly detection and 100% top-3 accuracy in anomaly localization.
摘要翻译: 异常检测与定位（ADL）对维持云系统的高可靠性与可用性至关重要。近期ADL研究聚焦指标与日志数据，事件数据仍相对未被探索。为弥补这一空白，我们提出EventADL——首个面向云服务系统事件的白盒式ADL框架。为驱动框架设计，我们对520个真实事故开展系统分析，就异常及其根因如何通过事件数据显现给出多项重要洞见。EventADL框架分三个阶段：离线训练、在线异常检测与异常定位。训练阶段，EventADL利用无标注历史数据学习用于点态异常检测的事件语义模式（ESP）与用于频率异常检测的事件频率模式（EFP）。在线检测阶段，事件流中显著偏离这些模式的数据被判定为异常。定位阶段，EventADL构建干预图，建模近期干预（即可通过事件观察到的系统变更）与所检出异常间的关系，实现自动根因定位。该框架无需标注数据即可高效运行并产生可解释结果。在三个真实云服务系统与两个真实事故上与十个最先进基线的对比评估表明，EventADL优于现有方法，异常检测F1不低于90%，异常定位top-3准确率达100%。
问题挑战: 异常检测与定位是云服务系统高可用性的关键保障，而现有研究聚焦指标与日志数据，事件数据尚未被充分探索。
核心方法: 基于对520个真实事故的系统分析提出白盒式框架EventADL，利用无标注历史数据学习事件语义模式与事件频率模式进行两类异常检测，并构建干预图实现自动根因定位。
主要效果: 在三个真实云服务系统上对比十个SOTA基线，异常检测F1不低于90%、异常定位top-3准确率达100%，且无需标注数据、结果可解释。
一句话总结: 针对云服务事件数据异常检测与定位缺乏有效手段的问题，研究事件模式学习与干预因果图构建技术，实现90%以上检测F1与100%的top-3定位准确率。
关键词: AIOps；异常检测；根因定位；事件数据；云服务系统

标题: Exorcist: Enabling Atomic-Level Runtime Detection of Spectre Attacks Using Precise Event Based Sampling
标题翻译: Exorcist：利用精确事件采样实现Spectre攻击的原子级运行时检测
作者列表: Hao Jia, Haoyu Ma, Changfeng Ding, Jinku Li（通讯）
单位: Hao Jia (Xidian University); Haoyu Ma (Beijing Jiaotong University); Changfeng Ding (Xidian University); Jinku Li（通讯） (Xidian University, China)
摘要: While being key hardware techniques for improving the performance of modern processors, the speculative execution mechanisms also lead to side-channel attacks, which pose significant threats to the security of computer systems. While researchers have proposed various solutions to mitigate the threat posed by speculative attacks, most existing approaches have focused on offline static vulnerability analysis, which suffers from significant limitations of incompleteness and poor scalability. Based on Intel’s Precise Event Based Sampling (PEBS) technique, this paper proposes Exorcist, a novel runtime framework for detecting Spectre-PHT attacks at the atomic level. Leveraging the key observation that the atomic execution of a Spectre-PHT gadget triggers both a cache miss and a branch mis-precision in a fixed sequence, Exorcist uses carefully configured PEBS monitoring to efficiently capture all related fine-grained hardware performance events, then launches a kernel- and user-level collaborated taint analysis to effectively pinpoint Spectre-PHT gadgets that have actually exploited vulnerable speculative executions. Our approach significantly reduces the amount of native instructions needed to be processed to confirm actual Spectre exploitation, making it capable of achieving high accuracy and a negligible false positive rate with second-level response time. We have implemented a prototype of Exorcist and performed a comprehensive evaluation on it. Experimental results indicate that Exorcist can efficiently detect Spectre-PHT attacks at runtime with acceptable performance overhead, including JIT-compiled Spectre-PHT payloads written in JavaScript that are beyond the reach of existing offline analysis-based approaches.
摘要翻译: 推测执行机制虽是提升现代处理器性能的关键硬件技术，却也引发侧信道攻击，对计算机系统安全构成严重威胁。尽管研究者已提出多种缓解方案，但多数现有工作聚焦离线静态漏洞分析，存在不完备与可扩展性差等显著局限。基于Intel精确事件采样（PEBS）技术，本文提出新颖的原子级运行时检测框架Exorcist，用于检测Spectre-PHT攻击。利用“Spectre-PHT gadget的原子执行会以固定顺序同时触发缓存未命中与分支误预测”这一关键观测，Exorcist通过精心配置的PEBS监控高效捕获所有相关的细粒度硬件性能事件，随后启动内核与用户级协作的污点分析，有效精准定位实际利用了易受攻击推测执行的Spectre-PHT gadget。我们的方法显著减少了确认实际Spectre利用所需处理的原生指令数量，从而以秒级响应时间实现高准确率与可忽略的误报率。我们实现了Exorcist原型并进行了全面评估。实验结果表明，Exorcist能以可接受的性能开销在运行时高效检测Spectre-PHT攻击，包括现有离线分析方法无法企及的JavaScript JIT编译的Spectre-PHT载荷。
问题挑战: 推测执行带来Spectre侧信道攻击威胁，而现有防御多为离线静态漏洞分析，存在不完备与可扩展性差的局限，难以检测JIT编译的攻击载荷。
核心方法: 基于Intel PEBS技术提出运行时检测框架Exorcist，利用Spectre-PHT gadget原子执行以固定顺序触发缓存未命中与分支误预测的观测，结合内核-用户级协作污点分析精准定位攻击gadget。
主要效果: 以秒级响应时间实现高准确率与可忽略误报率，可检测现有离线分析无法企及的JavaScript JIT编译Spectre-PHT载荷，性能开销可接受。
一句话总结: 针对Spectre攻击缺乏可扩展运行时检测手段的问题，研究PEBS硬件事件监控与污点分析协同技术，实现秒级、低误报的原子级攻击检测。
关键词: Spectre攻击；侧信道攻击；运行时检测；性能计数器；污点分析

标题: Feature Slice Matching for Precise Bug Detection
标题翻译: 面向精准缺陷检测的特征切片匹配
作者列表: Ke Ma, Jianjun Huang, Wei You, Bin Liang（通讯）, Jingzheng Wu, Yanjun Wu, Yuanjun Gong
单位: Ke Ma (Renmin University of China); Jianjun Huang (Renmin University of China); Wei You (Renmin University of China, China); Bin Liang（通讯） (Renmin University of China, China); Jingzheng Wu (Institute of Software, The Chinese Academy of Sciences); Yanjun Wu (Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences); Yuanjun Gong (University of Trento, Italy)
摘要: Measuring the function similarity to detect bugs is effective, but the statements unrelated to the bugs can impede the performance due to the noise interference. Suppressing the noise interference in existing works does not manage the tough job, i.e., eliminating the noise in the targets. In this paper, we propose MATUS to mitigate the target noise for precise bug detection based on similarity measurement. Feature slices are extracted from both the buggy query and the targets to represent the semantic feature of (potential) bug logics. In particular, MATUS guides the target slicing with the prior knowledge from the buggy code, in an end-to-end way to pinpoint the slicing criterion in the targets. All feature slices are embedded and compared based on the vector similarity. Buggy candidates are audited to confirm unknown bugs in the targets. Experiments show that MATUS holds advantages in bug detection for real-world projects with acceptable efficiency. In total, MATUS has spotted 31 unknown bugs in the Linux kernel. All of them have been confirmed by the kernel developers, and 11 have been assigned CVEs.
摘要翻译: 通过度量函数相似性检测缺陷行之有效，但与缺陷无关的语句会因噪声干扰妨碍性能。现有工作中的噪声抑制并未解决难题——即消除目标代码中的噪声。本文提出MATUS，基于相似性度量缓解目标噪声以实现精准缺陷检测。从缺陷查询与目标代码中提取特征切片，以表征（潜在）缺陷逻辑的语义特征。特别地，MATUS以缺陷代码的先验知识端到端地指导目标切片准则的定位。所有特征切片经嵌入后按向量相似性比较，再审计缺陷候选以确认目标中的未知缺陷。实验表明，MATUS在真实项目缺陷检测中兼具优势与可接受的效率。MATUS共在Linux内核中发现31个未知缺陷，全部获内核开发者确认，其中11个获CVE编号。
问题挑战: 基于函数相似度的缺陷检测中，与缺陷无关的语句引入噪声干扰性能，而现有工作未解决消除目标代码中噪声这一难题。
核心方法: 提出MATUS，从缺陷查询与目标代码中提取表征缺陷语义的特征切片，以缺陷代码先验知识端到端指导目标切片准则定位，对切片嵌入进行向量相似度比较以审计确认未知缺陷。
主要效果: 在真实项目缺陷检测中兼具优势与可接受效率，在Linux内核中发现31个未知缺陷，全部获内核开发者确认，11个获CVE编号。
一句话总结: 针对相似度缺陷检测中目标代码噪声干扰的问题，研究先验知识引导的特征切片匹配技术，实现Linux内核31个未知缺陷的精准检出。

标题: GadgetHunter: Region-Based Neuro-Symbolic Detection of Java Deserialization Vulnerabilities
标题翻译: GadgetHunter：基于区域划分的Java反序列化漏洞神经符号检测
作者列表: Kaixuan Li, Jian Zhang（通讯）, Chong Wang, Sen Chen, Zong Cao, Min Zhang, Yang Liu
单位: Kaixuan Li (Nanyang Technological University, Singapore); Jian Zhang（通讯） (Beihang University, China); Chong Wang (Nanyang Technological University); Sen Chen (Nankai University, China); Zong Cao (Imperial Global Singapore, Singapore); Min Zhang (East China Normal University, China); Yang Liu (Nanyang Technological University, Singapore)
摘要: Java deserialization vulnerabilities (JDVs) enable attackers to execute arbitrary code by crafting malicious serialized objects that trigger sequences of method calls (gadget chains) leading to dangerous operations. Existing detection approaches face a fundamental trade-off: static analysis achieves scalability but suffers from high false positives due to infeasible paths and imprecision with dynamic features like reflection; dynamic validation reduces false positives but incurs prohibitive costs and fails to explore deep exploitation chains. We present GadgetHunter, a neuro-symbolic JDV detector that combines scalable static analysis with targeted LLM reasoning and JDV exploitation-oriented constraint solving. Our approach partitions gadget chains into regions based on analyzability: statically resolvable segments are processed via interprocedural taint analysis, while dynamic boundaries are delegated to LLMs for semantic validation. We then extract critical constraints from each gadget and compose them into SMT formulas to determine chain feasibility through satisfiability solving. Evaluation on the ysoserial benchmark demonstrates that GadgetHunter reduces false negatives by up to 32% and false positives by 12-85% compared to state-of-the-art tools, while discovering 197 previously unknown gadget chains and rediscovering 4 recent CVEs. Our results show that combining symbolic reasoning with semantic understanding achieves both precision and practical impact in vulnerability detection.
摘要翻译: Java反序列化漏洞（JDV）使攻击者能够通过构造恶意序列化对象触发通往危险操作的方法调用序列（gadget链）从而执行任意代码。现有检测方法面临根本性权衡：静态分析具备可扩展性，但因不可行路径与反射等动态特性不精确而误报率高；动态验证降低误报，但成本过高且难以探索深层利用链。我们提出GadgetHunter——结合可扩展静态分析、定向LLM推理与JDV利用导向约束求解的神经符号JDV检测器。我们的方法按可分析性将gadget链分区：可静态解析的片段通过过程间污点分析处理，动态边界交由LLM进行语义验证。随后从每个gadget提取关键约束并组合成SMT公式，通过可满足性求解判定链可行性。在ysoserial基准上的评估表明，与最先进工具相比，GadgetHunter最多降低32%漏报与12%~85%误报，同时发现197个此前未知的gadget链并复现4个近期CVE。结果表明，符号推理与语义理解的结合可在漏洞检测中同时实现精度与实用影响。

核心方法: 提出神经符号检测器GadgetHunter，按可分析性对gadget链分区：可静态解析段用过程间污点分析、动态边界交由LLM语义验证，再抽取关键约束组成SMT公式判定链可行性。

一句话总结: 针对Java反序列化gadget链检测精度与开销矛盾的问题，研究静态分析、LLM推理与约束求解融合的神经符号技术，实现误报与漏报同步降低并发现197条新gadget链。

标题: Detecting Code-Comment Inconsistencies in Smart Contracts by Combining LLM and Program Analysis
标题翻译: 融合大语言模型与程序分析检测智能合约中的代码-注释不一致
作者列表: Jiashuo Zhang, Jiachi Chen（通讯）, Ting Zhang, Yue Li, Daoyuan Wu, Yanlin Wang, Jianbo Gao, Ting Chen, Zhong Chen（通讯）
单位: Jiashuo Zhang (Peking University, China); Jiachi Chen（通讯） (Zhejiang University); Ting Zhang (Peking University); Yue Li (Peking University); Daoyuan Wu (Lingnan University, Hong Kong SAR China); Yanlin Wang (Sun Yat-sen University, China); Jianbo Gao (Peking University, China); Ting Chen (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, China); Zhong Chen（通讯）
摘要: Smart contracts have attracted rapid development and widespread application. Due to the complexity of real-world smart contracts, it is error-prone to correctly enforce all intended functionalities in code implementations, resulting in unintended functional behaviors and security issues in practice. Code-comment inconsistency detection has emerged as an important solution to these issues, which leverages the redundant functional specifications in comments to detect code implementations that violate developers’ intentions. However, existing inconsistency detection solutions are typically pattern-based and limited to fixed types of inconsistencies, which prevents them from detecting the diverse inconsistencies between real-world code implementations and casually written comments. To bridge the gap, this paper presents SmartComment, the first technique that combines LLMs with program analysis techniques for detecting code-comment inconsistencies in smart contracts. SmartComment introduces an LLM-driven workflow which simulates real-world interactions between code reviewers and developers to identify inconsistencies. It incorporates various program analysis techniques into the workflow, including comment propagation and code context extraction for generating input context for inconsistency detection, as well as program variant generation and differential analysis for inconsistency confirmation. Our evaluation results show that SmartComment detects 203 valid inconsistencies from a dataset of 1,000 real-world contracts with a precision of 79.9%, highlighting its effectiveness in detecting prevalent and diverse real-world inconsistencies. Compared to previous work, SmartComment achieves both higher precision and recall, detecting over 90% of inconsistencies that existing methods fail to identify. Furthermore, an ablation experiment demonstrates the effectiveness of incorporating program analysis techniques into SmartComment, improving the F1-score from 58.7% to 81.3%.
摘要翻译: 智能合约发展迅速并得到广泛应用。由于真实智能合约的复杂性，在代码实现中正确执行全部预期功能易出错，导致实践中出现非预期的功能行为与安全问题。代码-注释不一致性检测已成为应对这些问题的重要方案，它利用注释中冗余的功能规约来检测违背开发者意图的代码实现。然而，现有不一致检测方案通常基于模式且局限于固定类型的不一致，无法检测真实代码实现与随意撰写的注释之间多样化的不一致。为弥合这一差距，本文提出SmartComment——首个结合LLM与程序分析技术检测智能合约代码-注释不一致的方法。SmartComment引入模拟代码评审者与开发者真实交互的LLM驱动工作流以识别不一致；并将多种程序分析技术融入工作流，包括用于生成检测输入上下文的注释传播与代码上下文提取，以及用于确认不一致的程序变体生成与差分分析。评估结果表明，SmartComment在1000个真实合约数据集上以79.9%的精度检出203处有效不一致，凸显其在检测普遍而多样的真实不一致方面的有效性。与先前工作相比，SmartComment兼具更高精度与召回率，能检出既有方法90%以上无法识别的不一致。此外，消融实验证明了融入程序分析技术的有效性，使F1值从58.7%提升至81.3%。
问题挑战: 智能合约代码实现易偏离开发者意图，而现有基于模式的代码-注释不一致检测只能识别固定类型的不一致，无法应对真实合约中多样化注释与实现的偏差。
核心方法: 提出SmartComment，构建模拟代码评审者与开发者交互的LLM驱动工作流，融合注释传播、代码上下文提取、程序变体生成与差分分析等程序分析技术进行不一致检测与确认。
主要效果: 在1000个真实合约上以79.9%精度检出203处有效不一致，检出既有方法90%以上无法识别的不一致，消融实验中F1值从58.7%提升至81.3%。
一句话总结: 针对智能合约代码与注释不一致难以检测的问题，研究LLM与程序分析融合技术，实现高精度、多样化的不一致性发现。
关键词: 智能合约；代码-注释一致性；大语言模型；程序分析；差分分析
作者团队简介: 共同通讯作者：陈嘉驰（Jiachi Chen），浙江大学百人计划研究员，研究方向为Web3与智能合约安全，多次获SIGSOFT杰出论文奖；陈钟（Zhong Chen），北京大学教授，研究方向为网络与信息安全、区块链安全。

分类: 五、安全攻防与大模型可信
标题: Fool Me If You Can: On the Robustness of Binary Code Similarity Detection Models against Semantics-preserving Transformations
标题翻译: 有本事就骗我：二进制代码相似性检测模型面对语义保持变换的鲁棒性
作者列表: Jiyong Uhm, Minseok Kim, Michalis Polychronakis, Hyungjoon Koo（通讯）
单位: Jiyong Uhm (Sungkyunkwan University); Minseok Kim (Sungkyunkwan University, South Korea); Michalis Polychronakis (Stony Brook University, United States); Hyungjoon Koo（通讯） (Sungkyunkwan University)
摘要: Binary analysis plays an essential role in cybersecurity, facilitating reverse engineering to reveal the inner workings of programs in the absence of source code. Traditional approaches, such as static and dynamic analysis, extract valuable insights from stripped binaries, but often demand substantial expertise and manual effort. Recent advances in deep learning have opened promising opportunities to enhance binary analysis by capturing latent features and disclosing underlying code semantics. Despite the growing number of binary analysis models based on machine learning, their robustness to adversarial code transformations remains underexplored. In this work, we evaluate the robustness of deep learning models for the task of binary code similarity detection (BCSD) under semantics-preserving transformations. The unique nature of machine instructions presents distinct challenges compared to the typical input perturbations found in other domains. To achieve our goal, we introduce asmFooler, a system that evaluates the resilience of BCSD models using a diverse set of adversarial code transformations that preserve functional semantics. We construct a dataset of 9,565 binary variants from 620 baseline samples by applying eight semantics-preserving transformations across six representative BCSD models. Our major findings highlight several key insights: i) model robustness highly relies on the design of the processing pipeline, including code pre-processing, model architecture, and internal feature selection, which collectively determine how code semantics are captured; ii) the effectiveness of adversarial transformations is bounded by a transformation budget, shaped by model-specific constraints such as input size limits and the expressive capacity of semantically equivalent instructions; iii) well-crafted adversarial transformations can be highly effective, even when introducing minimal perturbations; and iv) such transformations disrupt the model’s ability to recognize and focus on semantically significant instructions.
摘要翻译: 二进制分析在网络安全中扮演重要角色，可在缺乏源代码时通过逆向工程揭示程序内部机理。静态与动态分析等传统方法从剥离符号的二进制中提取有价值洞见，但往往需要大量专业知识与人工投入。深度学习的最新进展通过捕获潜在特征并揭示底层代码语义，为增强二进制分析带来机遇。尽管基于机器学习的二进制分析模型日益增多，其对对抗性代码变换的鲁棒性仍未被充分探索。本工作评估深度学习模型在语义保持变换下执行二进制代码相似性检测（BCSD）任务的鲁棒性。机器指令的独特性质使其有别于其他领域典型的输入扰动。为此，我们引入asmFooler系统，使用多种保持功能语义的对抗代码变换评估BCSD模型的韧性。我们从620个基线样本出发，对六个代表性BCSD模型施加八种语义保持变换，构建9565个二进制变体的数据集。主要发现包括：i）模型鲁棒性高度依赖处理流水线设计，代码预处理、模型架构与内部特征选择共同决定代码语义的捕获方式；ii）对抗变换的效果受变换预算约束，由输入大小限制与语义等价指令的表达能力等模型特定约束塑造；iii）精心构造的对抗变换即使引入极小扰动也非常有效；iv）此类变换会破坏模型识别并关注语义重要指令的能力。
问题挑战: 深度学习驱动的二进制代码相似性检测模型对对抗性代码变换的鲁棒性缺乏系统评估，且机器指令的独特性质使其有别于其他领域的典型输入扰动。
核心方法: 提出asmFooler系统，从620个基线样本出发对六个代表性BCSD模型施加八种语义保持变换构建9565个二进制变体数据集，系统评估模型鲁棒性并剖析失效机理。
主要效果: 揭示模型鲁棒性高度依赖处理流水线设计、对抗变换效果受变换预算约束、极小扰动变换亦高度有效且会破坏模型对语义关键指令的注意力等关键洞见。
一句话总结: 针对BCSD模型对抗鲁棒性不明的问题，研究语义保持代码变换与系统评估技术，实现对其脆弱机理与变换预算约束的深入揭示。
关键词: 二进制分析；代码相似性检测；对抗鲁棒性；语义保持变换；深度学习
作者团队简介: 通讯作者Hyungjoon Koo，韩国成均馆大学，研究方向为系统安全与二进制分析。

标题: Flash: Query-Efficient Black-Box Static Malware Evasion through Transferable GAN-Guided Modification Sequences
标题翻译: Flash：基于可迁移GAN引导修改序列的黑盒高效静态恶意代码逃逸
作者列表: Anyuan Sang, Li Yang（通讯）, Lu Zhou, Junbo Jia, Huipeng Yang
单位: Anyuan Sang (Xidian University, China); Li Yang（通讯） (Xidian University); Lu Zhou (Xidian University); Junbo Jia (Xidian University); Huipeng Yang (Xidian University)
摘要: Machine learning (ML)–based static malware detectors are widely deployed for Portable Executable (PE) files due to their scalability and efficiency, yet they remain vulnerable to carefully crafted adversarial perturbations. Existing black-box evasion methods either rely on transfer attacks, which break down when surrogate and target decision boundaries diverge, or on query-driven searches, which require impractically many queries. We present Flash, a two-phase adversarial framework tailored for static PE malware detection that integrates the strengths of both approaches. In the first phase, a generative adversarial network is trained against heterogeneous surrogate detectors to generate function-preserving PE modifications with inherent evasiveness. In the second phase, an evolutionary optimizer refines these sequences directly against the target model with a dual-objective fitness that balances evasion success and minimal perturbation cost. Experiments on 12,039 VirusShare PE files and six state-of-the-art static detectors demonstrate that Flash reduces query counts by 86% while maintaining bypass rates above 95.8%. Furthermore, adversarial training with Flash-generated samples reduces attack success rates by 82.4%, highlighting Flash’s utility for both exposing vulnerabilities and strengthening the robustness of static PE malware detectors.
摘要翻译: 基于机器学习（ML）的静态恶意代码检测器凭借可扩展性与高效性被广泛部署于可移植可执行（PE）文件检测，但面对精心构造的对抗扰动仍然脆弱。现有黑盒逃逸方法要么依赖迁移攻击（当代理与目标决策边界分化时失效），要么依赖查询驱动搜索（需要不切实际的大量查询）。我们提出Flash——面向静态PE恶意代码检测的两阶段对抗框架，融合两类方法的优势。第一阶段，训练生成对抗网络对抗异构代理检测器，生成天然具有逃逸性且保持功能的PE修改。第二阶段，进化优化器以兼顾逃逸成功与最小扰动成本的双目标适应度，直接针对目标模型精炼修改序列。在12039个VirusShare PE文件与六个最先进静态检测器上的实验表明，Flash将查询次数减少86%，同时保持95.8%以上的绕过率。此外，用Flash生成样本进行对抗训练可使攻击成功率下降82.4%，凸显Flash在暴露漏洞与增强静态PE检测器鲁棒性两方面的价值。
问题挑战: 基于机器学习的PE静态恶意代码检测器易受对抗扰动攻击，而现有黑盒逃逸方法或因代理与目标决策边界分化而失效，或需要不切实际的大量查询。
核心方法: 提出两阶段对抗框架Flash：第一阶段训练GAN对抗异构代理检测器生成保持功能且天然具逃逸性的PE修改，第二阶段以双目标适应度（逃逸成功与最小扰动）的进化优化器直接对目标模型精炼修改序列。
主要效果: 在12039个VirusShare样本与六个SOTA静态检测器上，查询次数减少86%且绕过率保持95.8%以上，用其样本对抗训练可使攻击成功率下降82.4%。
一句话总结: 针对静态恶意代码检测黑盒逃逸查询开销大的问题，研究GAN迁移引导与进化优化相结合的技术，实现查询减少86%、绕过率超95%的高效逃逸。

分类: 五、安全攻防与大模型可信
标题: Hallucinations in LLM-based Code Summarization: Unveiling, Detection, and Mitigation
标题翻译: 基于LLM的代码摘要中的幻觉：揭示、检测与缓解
作者列表: Guanghua Wan, Yuanning Feng, Yao Wan（通讯）, Zhaoyang Chu, Zhangqian Bi, Junxiao Han, Zhou Zhao, Hongyu Zhang, Pingpeng Yuan, Xuanhua Shi, Hai Jin
单位: Guanghua Wan (Huazhong University of Science and Technology); Yuanning Feng (Huazhong University of Science and Technology); Yao Wan（通讯） (Huazhong University of Science and Technology, China); Zhaoyang Chu (University College London (UCL), United Kingdom); Zhangqian Bi (Huazhong University of Science and Technology); Junxiao Han (Hangzhou City University, China); Zhou Zhao (Zhejiang University); Hongyu Zhang (Chongqing University, China); Pingpeng Yuan (Huazhong University of Science and Technology); Xuanhua Shi (Huazhong University of Science and Technology); Hai Jin (Huazhong University of Science and Technology, China)
摘要: Code summarization plays a vital role in program comprehension and software maintenance by generating natural language descriptions to summarize the semantics of code. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable performance in this area, recent empirical studies reveal a critical limitation: LLMs are prone to hallucinations, producing summaries that are factually inaccurate or unfaithful to the source code, potentially misleading developers. In this paper, we propose to unveil, detect, and mitigate hallucinations in LLM-based code summarization. First, we construct Hallu-Eval, a novel dataset for unveiling hallucination phenomena and rigorously evaluating the effectiveness of hallucination detection and mitigation in LLM-based code summarization. It comprises both original code snippets to capture naturally occurring hallucinations and their semantically perturbed counterparts, which are designed to systematically induce challenging logical hallucinations, all complemented with manual hallucination annotations. Next, we propose Hallu-Det, a synergistic approach that combines direct entity-level detection to identify explicit hallucinations with a synonymous mutation-based refinement to reliably confirm or refute more ambiguous cases. Finally, we introduce Hallu-Shield, an inference-time mitigation approach that leverages an external value model to guide LLMs toward producing more faithful summaries—without costly retraining of the LLM itself. Extensive experiments show that Hallu-Eval effectively triggers hallucinations, increasing the hallucination rate of models such as Qwen2.5-Coder-7B from 17% to 97% on perturbed code. Our detection approach, Hallu-Det, achieves the best performance among baselines, reaching an F1-score of 0.95 for summaries generated by Qwen2.5-Coder-7B. Moreover, our mitigation method, Hallu-Shield, reduces hallucination rates—for example, from 66% to 59%, a 10.6% relative reduction, on DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B—while simultaneously improving summary quality, achieving a 71.5% win rate in a side-by-side evaluation using an LLM as a judge.
摘要翻译: 代码摘要通过生成自然语言描述概括代码语义，在程序理解与软件维护中扮演重要角色。尽管大语言模型（LLM）在此领域表现出色，近期实证研究揭示一个关键局限：LLM易产生幻觉，生成事实不准确或不忠于源代码的摘要，可能误导开发者。本文研究LLM代码摘要中幻觉的揭示、检测与缓解。首先，我们构建Hallu-Eval——用于揭示幻觉现象并严格评估LLM代码摘要中幻觉检测与缓解效果的新数据集，包含捕获自然发生幻觉的原始代码片段与系统诱导挑战性逻辑幻觉的语义扰动版本，均辅以人工幻觉标注。其次，我们提出Hallu-Det——结合实体级直接检测识别显式幻觉与基于同义变异的精炼确认以可靠判定模糊案例的协同方法。最后，我们提出Hallu-Shield——利用外部价值模型引导LLM产生更忠实摘要的推理时缓解方法，无需对LLM本身进行昂贵重训练。大量实验表明，Hallu-Eval有效触发幻觉，将Qwen2.5-Coder-7B等模型在扰动代码上的幻觉率从17%提升到97%。检测方法Hallu-Det在基线中表现最佳，对Qwen2.5-Coder-7B生成的摘要达到0.95的F1值。缓解方法Hallu-Shield降低幻觉率——例如在DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B上从66%降至59%（相对降低10.6%）——同时提升摘要质量，在LLM裁判的并排对比评估中获得71.5%胜率。
问题挑战: 代码摘要任务中LLM易产生与源码不符的幻觉内容、可能误导开发者，但幻觉现象的系统性揭示与高效检测、缓解手段仍缺乏。
核心方法: 构建含原始与语义扰动代码及人工标注的幻觉评测集Hallu-Eval，提出结合实体级直接检测与同义变异精炼确认的Hallu-Det，以及推理时以外部价值模型引导生成的Hallu-Shield。
主要效果: Hallu-Eval将Qwen2.5-Coder-7B幻觉率从17%提升到97%以充分暴露问题；Hallu-Det达最优F1值0.95；Hallu-Shield降低幻觉率（66%→59%）并使摘要质量获71.5%胜率。

标题: DualCodeDetect: Zero-Shot LLM-Generated Code Detection via Dual-Channel Perturbation
标题翻译: DualCodeDetect：基于双通道扰动的零样本LLM生成代码检测
作者列表: Zhengdao Li, Xiuwei Shang, Zhenkan Fu, Shikai Guo, Weiming Zhang, Nenghai Yu, Kejiang Chen（通讯）
单位: Zhengdao Li (University of Science and Technology of China); Xiuwei Shang (University of Science and Technology of China, China); Zhenkan Fu (University of Science and Technology of China); Shikai Guo (Dalian Maritime University, China); Weiming Zhang (University of Science and Technology of China, China); Nenghai Yu (School of Cyber Security, University of Science and Technology of China); Kejiang Chen（通讯） (University of Science and Technology of China, China)
摘要: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) in code generation has greatly improved software development efficiency, but it has also raised concerns about misuse, making the distinction between human-written and LLM-generated code an urgent task. However, existing detection methods for LLM-generated content, particularly perturbation-based zero-shot methods, are primarily designed for natural language scenarios and fail to transfer effectively to the task of detecting generated code. When directly applied to code, they face two major challenges: (1) the low-entropy nature of code restricts the perturbation space and weakens discriminative signals; and (2) prior perturbation methods often compromise semantic integrity or executability, leading to substantial performance degradation. To address these issues, we propose DualCodeDetect, a novel zero-shot detection framework that amplifies the differences between LLM-generated and human-written code through a dual-channel perturbation mechanism. In the semantic channel, we design an identifier perturbation strategy based on outside-nucleus sampling, which disrupts the strong consistency of LLMs in identifier selection. In the structural channel, empirical analysis reveals that LLM-generated code exhibits greater uniformity in stylistic features; leveraging this insight, we construct a rule-based library of semantics-preserving code transformations to introduce structural perturbations that further magnify statistical disparities. In experiments conducted across two datasets and six representative code LLMs, DualCodeDetect achieves an average AUROC of 0.8535 under both T=0.2 and T=1.0 temperature settings, demonstrating significant superiority over existing detection methods.
摘要翻译: 大语言模型（LLM）在代码生成上的快速进步极大提升了软件开发效率，但也引发滥用担忧，使区分人类编写与LLM生成的代码成为紧迫任务。然而，现有LLM生成内容检测方法（尤其是基于扰动的零样本方法）主要面向自然语言场景，难以有效迁移到生成代码检测任务。直接应用于代码时，它们面临两大挑战：（1）代码的低熵特性限制了扰动空间并削弱判别信号；（2）已有扰动方法常损害语义完整性或可执行性，导致性能大幅下降。为解决这些问题，我们提出新颖的零样本检测框架DualCodeDetect，通过双通道扰动机制放大LLM生成代码与人类编写代码的差异。在语义通道，我们设计基于核外采样的标识符扰动策略，破坏LLM在标识符选择上的强一致性；在结构通道，实证分析揭示LLM生成代码在风格特征上更趋同，基于此洞见，我们构建保持语义的代码变换规则库以引入结构扰动，进一步放大统计差异。在两个数据集与六个代表性代码LLM上的实验中，DualCodeDetect在T=0.2与T=1.0两种温度设置下平均AUROC达0.8535，显著优于现有检测方法。
问题挑战: 区分人类编写与LLM生成的代码日益迫切，但面向自然语言的零样本扰动检测方法难以迁移到代码：代码低熵特性限制扰动空间，且扰动易破坏语义完整性与可执行性。
核心方法: 提出双通道扰动框架DualCodeDetect：语义通道以基于核外采样的标识符扰动破坏LLM标识符选择的一致性，结构通道以保持语义的代码变换规则库放大风格统计差异。
主要效果: 在两个数据集、六个代表性代码LLM上，T=0.2与T=1.0两种温度设置下平均AUROC达0.8535，显著优于现有检测方法。
一句话总结: 针对零样本检测LLM生成代码时扰动空间受限、语义易受损的问题，研究语义-结构双通道扰动技术，实现平均AUROC 0.8535的检测性能。
关键词: 生成代码检测；零样本检测；双通道扰动；大语言模型；AIGC治理

标题: DuCodeMark: Dual-Purpose Code Dataset Watermarking via Style-Aware Watermark–Poison Design
标题翻译: DuCodeMark：基于风格感知水印-投毒设计的双用途代码数据集水印
作者列表: Yuchen Chen, Yuan Xiao, Chunrong Fang（通讯）, Zhenyu Chen, Baowen Xu
单位: Yuchen Chen (Nanjing University); Yuan Xiao (Nanjing University, China); Chunrong Fang（通讯） (Nanjing University, China); Zhenyu Chen (Nanjing University, China); Baowen Xu (Nanjing University)
摘要: The proliferation of large language models for code (CodeLLMs) and open-source contributions has heightened concerns over unauthorized use of source code datasets. While watermarking provides a viable protection mechanism by embedding ownership signals, existing methods rely on detectable trigger–target patterns and are limited to source-level tasks, overlooking binary-level scenarios such as decompilation. In this paper, we propose DuCodeMark, a stealthy and robust dual-purpose watermarking method for code datasets that generalizes across both source-level and binary-level code tasks. DuCodeMark parses each code sample into an abstract syntax tree (AST), applies language-specific style transformations to construct stealthy trigger–target pairs, and injects repressible poisoned features into a subset of return-typed samples to enhance robustness against watermark removal or evasion. These features remain inactive during normal training but are activated upon watermark removal, degrading model performance. For verification, DuCodeMark employs a black-box method based on the independent-samples $t$-test. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of DuCodeMark across 72 settings spanning two code tasks, two programming languages, three CodeLLMs, and six decoding temperatures. The results demonstrate that it consistently achieves strong verifiability ($p < 0.05$), high stealthiness (suspicious rate $\leq$ 0.36), robustness against both watermark and poisoning attacks (recall $\leq$ 0.57), and a substantial drop in model performance upon watermark removal (Pass@1 drops by 28.6%), underscoring its practicality and resilience.
摘要翻译: 代码大语言模型（CodeLLM）与开源贡献的激增加剧了对源代码数据集被未经授权使用的担忧。水印通过嵌入所有权信号提供了可行的保护机制，但现有方法依赖可检测的触发-目标模式且局限于源码级任务，忽视了反编译等二进制级场景。本文提出DuCodeMark——一种隐蔽且鲁棒的代码数据集双用途水印方法，可同时泛化到源码级与二进制级代码任务。DuCodeMark将每个代码样本解析为抽象语法树（AST），施加语言特定的风格变换以构造隐蔽的触发-目标对，并向带返回类型的部分样本注入可抑制的投毒特征，以增强对水印移除或规避的鲁棒性。这些特征在正常训练中保持休眠，而在水印被移除时被激活，使模型性能下降。验证时，DuCodeMark采用基于独立样本t检验的黑盒方法。我们在涵盖两种代码任务、两种编程语言、三种CodeLLM与六种解码温度的72种设置下对DuCodeMark进行全面评估。结果表明，其始终实现强可验证性（p<0.05）、高隐蔽性（可疑率≤0.36）、对水印攻击与投毒攻击的鲁棒性（召回率≤0.57），以及水印移除后模型性能的大幅下降（Pass@1下降28.6%），凸显其实用性与韧性。
问题挑战: 开源代码数据集易被未经授权使用，现有水印方法依赖可检测的触发-目标模式且局限于源码级任务，忽视反编译等二进制级场景。
核心方法: 提出DuCodeMark，将代码解析为AST并施加语言特定风格变换构造隐蔽触发-目标对，向带返回类型样本注入水印移除时激活的投毒特征，并采用基于独立样本t检验的黑盒验证。
主要效果: 在72种设置（2任务×2语言×3模型×6温度）中实现强可验证性（p<0.05）、高隐蔽性（可疑率≤0.36）与强鲁棒性，水印移除后模型Pass@1下降28.6%。
一句话总结: 针对代码数据集版权保护及二进制级水印缺失的问题，研究风格感知的触发构造与投毒增强技术，实现源码级与二进制级任务均可验证的鲁棒水印。
关键词: 代码数据集水印；投毒机制；风格变换；版权保护；代码大模型
作者团队简介: 通讯作者房春荣（Chunrong Fang），南京大学软件学院副教授、博导，研究方向为BigCode与AI测试，聚焦软件测试与代码大模型数据安全。

标题: Fairness Testing of Large Language Models in Role-Playing
标题翻译: 大语言模型角色扮演中的公平性测试
作者列表: Xinyue Li, Zhenpeng Chen（通讯）, Jie M. Zhang, Ying Xiao, Li Tianlin, Weisong Sun, Yang Liu, Yiling Lou, Xuanzhe Liu
单位: Xinyue Li (Peking University); Zhenpeng Chen（通讯） (Tsinghua University, China); Jie M. Zhang (Mistral AI and King's College London, United Kingdom); Ying Xiao; Li Tianlin; Weisong Sun (Nanyang Technological University, Singapore); Yang Liu (Nanyang Technological University, Singapore); Yiling Lou (University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, United States); Xuanzhe Liu (Peking University, China)
摘要: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become foundational in modern language-driven software applications, profoundly influencing daily life. A critical technique in leveraging their potential is role-playing, where LLMs simulate diverse roles to enhance their real-world utility. However, while research has highlighted the presence of social biases in LLM outputs, it remains unclear whether and to what extent these biases emerge during role-playing scenarios. In this paper, we conduct an empirical study on fairness testing of LLMs in role-playing scenarios. To enable this testing, we use LLMs to generate 550 social roles spanning a comprehensive set of 11 demographic attributes, producing 33,000 role-specific questions that target various forms of bias. These questions, covering Yes/No, multiple-choice, and open-ended formats, are designed to prompt LLMs to adopt specific roles and respond accordingly. We employ a combination of rule-based and LLM-based strategies to identify biased responses, rigorously validated through human evaluation. Using the generated questions as the test cases, we conduct extensive evaluations of 10 advanced LLMs. The evaluation reveal 107,580 biased responses across the studied LLMs, with individual models yielding between 7,579 and 16,963 biased responses, underscoring the prevalence of bias in role-playing contexts. To support future research, we have publicly released the dataset, along with all scripts and experimental results.
摘要翻译: 大语言模型（LLM）已成为现代语言驱动软件应用的基础，深刻影响日常生活。发挥其潜力的关键技术之一是角色扮演，即LLM模拟多样角色以增强其实用性。然而，尽管研究已指出LLM输出中存在社会偏见，这些偏见是否以及在多大程度上会在角色扮演场景中显现仍不明确。本文对LLM在角色扮演场景中的公平性开展实证研究。为支撑该测试，我们使用LLM生成覆盖11个人口统计属性的550个社会角色，产生针对各种偏见形式的33000个角色特定问题。这些问题涵盖是非题、多选题与开放题，旨在促使LLM扮演特定角色并作答。我们采用基于规则与基于LLM的策略组合识别偏见回复，并经人工评估严格验证。以生成的问题为测试用例，我们对10个先进LLM开展广泛评估。评估揭示所研究LLM中存在107580条偏见回复，单个模型介于7579至16963条，凸显角色扮演场景中偏见的普遍性。为支持后续研究，我们公开了数据集及全部脚本与实验结果。
问题挑战: 角色扮演是发挥LLM实用潜力的重要技术，但社会偏见是否以及在多大程度上会在角色扮演场景中显现尚不明确，缺乏系统性公平性测试。
核心方法: 使用LLM生成覆盖11个人口统计属性的550个社会角色与33000个角色特定偏见问题（含是非、多选与开放题型），结合规则与LLM策略识别偏见回复并经人工评估验证。
主要效果: 对10个先进LLM的评估发现107580条偏见回复（单模型7579至16963条），揭示角色扮演场景中偏见的普遍性，并公开数据集与全部实验材料。
一句话总结: 针对LLM角色扮演场景偏见程度不明的问题，研究大规模角色化测试问题生成与偏见识别技术，实现10个LLM中10万余条偏见回复的系统性揭示。
关键词: 公平性测试；大语言模型；角色扮演；社会偏见；可信AI

标题: InDe-LLM: Defending Against Jailbreak Attacks in LLM-Powered Systems via Intention Disentangling
标题翻译: InDe-LLM：通过意图解耦防御LLM系统中的越狱攻击
作者列表: Yujue Wang, Quan Zhang（通讯）, Chijin Zhou（通讯）, Gwihwan Go, Dalong Shi, Yu Jiang
单位: YujueWang (Tsinghua University); Quan Zhang（通讯） (East China Normal University, China); Chijin Zhou（通讯） (East China Normal University, China); Gwihwan Go (Tsinghua University); Dalong Shi (AVIC International Digital Network Technology Co., Ltd.); Yu Jiang (Tsinghua University, China)
摘要: Jailbreak attacks have been regarded as a crucial threat to LLM-powered software systems. Recent studies indicate the existence of a steering vector within models’ internal activations, which can adjust a model’s propensity to reject user requests, and thus is regarded as an effective approach for training-free defense. However, attackers may wrap their malicious intentions within a seemingly benign context, which shifts the distribution of harmful prompts toward benign inputs along the steering vector, effectively bypassing existing defense approaches. In this work, we propose a defense framework InDe-LLM based on intention disentangling. By projecting the embedding of inputs into a benign-invariant subspace, we could disentangle the harmful intentions of jailbreak prompts without affecting benign inputs. Next, such disentangled harmful intentions can be easily identified based on LLMs’ well-aligned concept of harmfulness, and rejected through activation steering. Our experiments show that InDe-LLM achieves high defense effectiveness, outperforming baselines by 27.2%–43.5% across three models and ten attacks while preserving high utility on benign inputs. Moreover, our evaluation demonstrates that it exhibits high transferability to unseen attacks.
摘要翻译: 越狱攻击已被视为LLM驱动软件系统的关键威胁。近期研究表明，模型内部激活中存在一个转向向量，可调节模型拒绝用户请求的倾向，因而被视为有效的免训练防御手段。然而，攻击者可能将恶意意图包装在看似良性的上下文中，使有害提示的分布沿转向向量向良性输入漂移，从而有效绕过现有防御。本工作提出基于意图解耦的防御框架InDe-LLM。通过将输入嵌入投影到良性不变子空间，我们可在不影响良性输入的前提下解耦越狱提示中的有害意图。随后，可基于LLM自身良好的有害性对齐概念轻松识别这些被解耦的有害意图，并通过激活转向加以拒绝。实验表明，InDe-LLM取得显著防御效果，在三个模型与十种攻击上超越基线27.2%~43.5%，同时在良性输入上保持高可用性。此外，评估表明其对未见攻击具有高可迁移性。
问题挑战: 基于激活转向的免训练防御可被攻击者将恶意意图包装于良性上下文而绕过，使有害提示分布沿转向向量向良性输入漂移，威胁LLM系统安全。
核心方法: 提出基于意图解耦的防御框架InDe-LLM，将输入嵌入投影到良性不变子空间以解耦越狱提示中的有害意图，再利用LLM自身的有害性对齐概念识别并经激活转向拒绝。
主要效果: 在三个模型与十种攻击上防御效果超越基线27.2%~43.5%，同时保持良性输入高可用性，并对未见攻击具有高可迁移性。
一句话总结: 针对越狱攻击绕过激活转向防御的问题，研究良性不变子空间意图解耦技术，实现防御效果27.2%~43.5%的领先提升。
关键词: 越狱攻击；LLM安全；激活转向；意图解耦；对抗防御
作者团队简介: 共同通讯作者：张泉（Quan Zhang）与周炽金（Chijin Zhou），均为华东师范大学软件工程学院助理教授（晨晖学者）、清华大学博士，研究方向为软件系统与AI系统安全、LLM越狱攻防，主导开源框架EasyJailbreak。

分类: 六、实证方法、开发者研究与软件工程教育
标题: Evaluating Risk and Confidence in Performance Bounds of Configuration Sampling Strategies
标题翻译: 配置采样策略性能界的风险与置信度评估
作者列表: Kallistos Weis, Martina Maggio, Norbert Siegmund, Sven Apel
单位: Kallistos Weis (Saarland University); Martina Maggio (Saarland University, Germany / Lund University, Sweden, Germany); Norbert Siegmund (Leipzig University, Germany); Sven Apel (Saarland University, Germany)
摘要: Modern software usually exposes a large number of configuration options to the user, which gives rise to enormous configuration spaces in practice. Appropriate choices for these options dramatically influence the performance of the software (throughput, memory consumption, execution time, etc.). However, due to the sheer size of the configuration space, systematically identifying the best or worst-performing configurations is computationally infeasible through exhaustive exploration. Instead, practitioners rely on budgeted sampling strategies, such as uniform random sampling or statistical recursive search, to explore the configuration space under fixed measurement budgets in an attempt to find the best or worst configuration. A fundamental limitation of existing sampling strategies is the lack of quantifiable guarantees that the selected configuration truly reflects best-case (or worst-case) performance. In this paper, we define the basic concepts of \emph{posterior risk} and \emph{posterior confidence} and present a probabilistic framework to evaluate how well sampling strategies identify the best- or worst-performing configuration of a software system. We evaluate our framework by comparing five representative sampling strategies on seven real-world configurable software systems. Using our framework, we find that statistical recursive search yields consistently tighter best-case guarantees—higher posterior confidence and lower posterior risk—than the alternatives at the same budget. Our results demonstrate the potential of our framework as a principled basis for reporting, comparing, and refining sampling strategies, and as a tool for practitioners to select strategies and budgets with quantified guarantees across systems and sample sizes. Extended ablations—including additional sampling strategies and per-system breakdowns—are available in the supplementary material.
摘要翻译: 现代软件通常向用户暴露大量配置选项，导致实践中出现巨大的配置空间。这些选项的恰当选择会显著影响软件性能（吞吐量、内存消耗、执行时间等）。然而，由于配置空间规模巨大，通过穷举探索系统地识别最佳或最差性能配置在计算上不可行。实践者转而依赖预算受限的采样策略（如均匀随机采样或统计递归搜索），在固定测量预算下探索配置空间以寻找最佳或最差配置。现有采样策略的一个根本局限在于，缺乏可量化的保证来确认所选配置确实反映了最佳（或最差）情形性能。本文定义后验风险与后验置信度的基本概念，并提出一个概率框架来评估采样策略识别软件系统最佳或最差性能配置的优劣。我们在七个真实可配置软件系统上比较五种代表性采样策略以评估该框架。利用该框架，我们发现统计递归搜索在相同预算下始终产生更紧的最优情形保证——更高的后验置信度与更低的后验风险。结果表明，该框架可作为报告、比较与改进采样策略的规范化基础，也可作为实践者在不同系统与样本规模下选择策略与预算并获得量化保证的工具。包括更多采样策略与逐系统分析的扩展消融见补充材料。
问题挑战: 可配置软件的配置空间巨大，实践者依赖预算受限的采样策略寻找最优/最差性能配置，但现有策略缺乏所选配置确实反映最优/最差性能的可量化保证。
核心方法: 定义后验风险与后验置信度概念，提出评估采样策略识别最优/最差配置能力的概率框架，并在七个真实可配置系统上比较五种代表性采样策略。
主要效果: 发现统计递归搜索在相同预算下始终产生更紧的最优情形保证（更高后验置信度、更低后验风险），框架可作为采样策略报告、比较与改进的规范化基础。
一句话总结: 针对配置采样策略缺乏性能保证量化的问题，研究后验风险与置信度评估框架技术，实现采样策略的规范化比较与预算选择指导。
关键词: 可配置软件；性能预测；采样策略；后验置信度；配置空间

标题: In Bugs We Trust? On Measuring the Randomness of a Fuzzer Benchmarking Outcome
标题翻译: 该信任缺陷结论吗？论模糊测试器基准评测结果随机性的度量
作者列表: Ardi Madadi, Seongmin Lee, Cornelius Aschermann, Marcel Böhme
单位: Ardi Madadi (Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy, Germany); Seongmin Lee (UCLA, United States); Cornelius Aschermann (Ruhr-University Bochum); Marcel Böhme (MPI for Security and Privacy, Germany)
摘要: In Google’s FuzzBench platform, we find that the outcome of coverage-based evaluation more strongly agrees with the outcome of a bug-based evaluation than an independent bug-based evaluation itself. Recently, Böhme et al. found that despite a very strong correlation between coverage achieved and bugs found, there is no strong agreement between the outcome of a coverage- and a bug-based evaluation: The fuzzer best at achieving coverage may be the worst at finding bugs. However, in trying to explain this moderate agreement, we wondered whether the outcome of bug-based benchmarking itself is perhaps much more “noisy” and turned to applied statistics to develop the tools necessary to investigate our hypothesis. In this paper, we call this degree of “noisyness” of a benchmarking outcome as the \emph{concordance} of the benchmarking procedure and quantify it using a measure of statistical reliability widely-used in psychology, called \emph{mean split-half reliability}, i.e., the expected agreement on benchmark outcome between two random halfs of the benchmark set. In our experiments with FuzzBench and Magma, we find that the concordance of coverage-based benchmarking is consistently strong while that of bug-based benchmarking is weak on FuzzBench and moderate on Magma. In contrast to FuzzBench, for the Magma benchmark set, which was designed for bug-based evaluation, a coverage-based evaluation does \emph{not} predict the outcome of a bug-based evaluation better than an independent bug-based evaluation. We investigate concordance as a measure of benchmarking efficiency, as in green fuzzer benchmarking. We empirically confirm, the resources of a procedure with higher concordance can be reduced more substantially (in terms of campaign length or benchmark set size) while maintaining a similar benchmark outcome than a procedure with lower concordance. We report the corresonding savings in terms of carbon emissions.
摘要翻译: 在Google的FuzzBench平台上，我们发现覆盖导向评估与缺陷导向评估结论的一致程度高于两次独立的缺陷导向评估之间的一致程度。近来Böhme等人发现，尽管覆盖与缺陷发现之间相关性很强，覆盖导向与缺陷导向评估的结论并不强一致：最擅长覆盖的模糊器可能在缺陷发现上表现最差。在试图解释这种中等一致性时，我们怀疑缺陷导向评测本身的结论或许“噪声”更大，并借助应用统计学开发检验该假设所需的工具。本文将评测结论的这种“噪声”程度称为评测过程的一致性（concordance），并用心理学广泛使用的统计可靠性度量——平均分半信度（即两个随机半基准集上评测结论的期望一致性）加以量化。在FuzzBench与Magma上的实验中，我们发现覆盖导向评测的一致性始终较强，而缺陷导向评测在FuzzBench上一致性弱、在Magma上中等。与FuzzBench不同，在专为缺陷导向评估设计的Magma基准集上，覆盖导向评估并不能比独立的缺陷导向评估更好地预测缺陷导向评估的结论。我们将一致性作为评测效率的度量加以研究，服务于绿色模糊测试评测。我们实证确认，一致性更高的过程可在保持相似评测结论的前提下更大幅度地缩减资源（实验时长或基准集规模），并报告了相应的碳排放节省。
问题挑战: 尽管覆盖率与缺陷发现强相关，覆盖导向与缺陷导向的模糊器评测结论一致性却仅中等，缺陷导向评测自身的“噪声”程度（一致性）未被量化，影响评测可信度与资源效率。
核心方法: 借鉴心理学的平均分半信度定义评测过程的一致性（两个随机半基准集上结论的期望一致程度），并在FuzzBench与Magma上系统度量覆盖导向与缺陷导向评测的一致性。
主要效果: 发现覆盖导向评测一致性始终较强，缺陷导向评测在FuzzBench上弱、在Magma上中等；一致性高的流程可在保持结论前提下大幅缩减实验规模并节省碳排放。
一句话总结: 针对模糊器评测结论随机性未量化的问题，研究分半信度式一致性度量技术，实现评测资源与碳排放的规模化缩减。
关键词: 模糊测试；基准评测；统计可靠性；分半信度；绿色计算

标题: How Low Can You Go? The Data-Light SE Challenge
标题翻译: 数据可以少到什么程度？轻数据软件工程挑战
作者列表: Kishan Kumar Ganguly, Tim Menzies
单位: Kishan Kumar Ganguly (NC State); Tim Menzies (North Carolina State University, United States)
摘要: Much of software engineering (SE) research assumes that progress depends on massive datasets and CPU-intensive optimizers. Yet has this assumption been rigorously tested? The counter-evidence presented in this paper suggests otherwise. For over 100 optimization tasks from recent SE papers (including software configuration, performance tuning, product line engineering, project health forecasting, defect prediction, software testing, software process and cost estimation, and cross-domain generalization datasets), even with just a few dozen labels, very simple methods (e.g., diversity sampling, a minimal Bayesian learner, its distance-based non-parametric variant, or random probes) achieve over 90% of the best reported results. Furthermore, these simple methods perform just as well as more complex state-of-the-art optimizers like SMAC, TPE, DEHB, etc. While some tasks would require better outcomes and more sampling, these results seen after a few dozen samples would suffice for many engineering needs (particularly when the goal is rapid and cost-efficient guidance rather than slow and exhaustive optimization). To say that another way, at least some SE tasks are better served by lightweight approaches that demand fewer labels and far less computation. We hence propose the data-light challenge: when will a handful of labels suffice for SE tasks? To enable a large-scale investigation of this issue, we contribute (1) a mathematical formalization of labeling, (2) lightweight baseline algorithms, and (3) results on public-domain data showing the conditions under which lightweight methods excel or fail. For the purposes of open science, our scripts and data are online at https://github.com/KKGanguly/NEO.
摘要翻译: 软件工程（SE）研究的很大部分假设进展依赖于海量数据集与CPU密集型优化器。但这一假设被严格检验过吗？本文给出的反面证据表明并非如此。对于近期SE论文中的100余项优化任务（包括软件配置、性能调优、产品线工程、项目健康预测、缺陷预测、软件测试、软件过程与成本估算及跨领域泛化数据集），即便只有几十个标签，极简方法（如多样性采样、最小贝叶斯学习器、其基于距离的非参数变体或随机探测）也能达到最佳已报告结果的90%以上。此外，这些简单方法与SMAC、TPE、DEHB等更复杂的最先进优化器表现相当。尽管某些任务需要更好结果与更多采样，几十个样本后的结果已足以满足许多工程需求（尤其当目标是快速且高性价比的指导，而非缓慢穷举的优化）。换言之，至少部分SE任务更适合轻量方法——所需标签更少、计算开销大幅降低。因此我们提出轻数据挑战：何时少量标签足以完成SE任务？为支持对该问题的大规模研究，我们贡献：（1）标注的数学形式化；（2）轻量基线算法；（3）公开数据上的结果，展示轻量方法出色或失效的条件。出于开放科学目的，我们的脚本与数据已在线公开。
问题挑战: 软件工程研究普遍假设进展依赖海量数据与CPU密集型优化器，但该假设从未被严格检验，轻量方法何时足够尚无系统性答案。
核心方法: 对近期SE论文的100余项优化任务，实证比较多样性采样、极简贝叶斯学习器等轻量方法与SMAC、TPE、DEHB等复杂优化器，并提出标注的数学形式化与轻量基线算法。
主要效果: 仅数十个标签下简单方法即可达到最佳已报告结果的90%以上、与SOTA复杂优化器表现相当，据此提出“轻数据挑战”并开源全部脚本与数据。
一句话总结: 针对SE任务是否必需大数据与重型优化器的疑问，研究轻量采样与极简学习技术，实现数十标签下达90%以上最优性能的效果。
关键词: 软件工程；轻数据学习；贝叶斯优化；采样策略；实证研究

标题: How Do Developers Interact with AI? An Exploratory Study on Modeling Developer Programming Behavior
标题翻译: 开发者如何与AI交互？开发者编程行为建模的探索性研究
作者列表: Yinan Wu, Ze Shi (Zane) Li, Kathryn Stolee, Bowen Xu（通讯）
单位: Yinan Wu (North Carolina State University, United States); Ze Shi (Zane) Li (University of Oklahoma, United States); Kathryn Stolee (North Carolina State University, United States); Bowen Xu（通讯） (North Carolina State University, United States)
摘要: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping how developers adopt software engineering practices, yet the multi-dimensional nature of developer-AI interaction remains under-explored. Prior studies have primarily examined dimensions observable from developer activities such as “Prompt Crafting” and “Code Editing,” overlooking how hidden intentions and emotional dimensions intertwine with concrete actions during AI-assisted programming. Understanding the interplay is essential for improving developer experience and future AI assistant designs. To understand this phenomenon, we conducted a mixed-methods study with 76 developers. We first split developers into AI-assisted and non-AI groups. Each performed a programming task (either Python with API management or Java with SQL). Developers retrospectively labeled their self-reported intentions, tool-supported actions, and emotions (on a 7-point valence scale) from screen recordings, supplemented by participant surveys and interviews. Our user study resulted in a novel model, named S-IASE, with four dimensions to describe programming behavior for a given development state: intention, action, supporting tool, and emotion. Our analysis reveals several aggregated and sequential behavioral patterns. For example, for aggregated patterns, using AI assistants often led developers to focus more on actively “creating” code, evaluating, and verifying the generated results; for sequential patterns, AI-assisted participants showed emotionally stable development flows, as opposed to non-AI-assisted participants who experienced more fluctuating emotions. Interviews revealed further nuance: some developers reported impostor-like feelings, expressing guilt or self-doubt about relying on AI for programming. The uncovered patterns indicate that our model can provide actionable insights for improving AI assistants’ responsiveness, training developers in AI collaboration, and designing developer-centric AI studies. Our work bridges an important gap in understanding the complexities of developer-AI interaction in the programming context and sheds light on future developer-centric research directions.
摘要翻译: 人工智能（AI）正重塑开发者采用软件工程实践的方式，但开发者-AI交互的多维特性仍未被充分探索。先前研究主要考察可从开发者活动观察到的维度（如“提示词编写”与“代码编辑”），忽视了AI辅助编程过程中隐含意图与情感维度如何与具体行动交织。理解这种交互对改善开发者体验与未来AI助手设计至关重要。为此，我们对76名开发者开展混合方法研究。我们先将开发者分为AI辅助与非AI两组，各自执行一项编程任务（Python API管理或Java SQL）。开发者从屏幕录像回溯标注其自述意图、工具支持行动与情感（七点效价量表），辅以参与者问卷与访谈。用户研究产生了名为S-IASE的新模型，以四个维度描述给定开发状态下的编程行为：意图、行动、支持工具与情感。分析揭示了若干聚合与序列行为模式。例如在聚合模式上，使用AI助手常使开发者更聚焦主动“创建”代码、评估与验证生成结果；在序列模式上，AI辅助参与者表现出情感稳定的开发流，而非AI辅助参与者情感波动更多。访谈揭示更多细节：一些开发者报告了冒名顶替感（imposter syndrome），对依赖AI编程表达愧疚或自我怀疑。所揭示的模式表明，我们的模型可为改进AI助手响应性、开展开发者AI协作培训与设计以开发者为中心的AI研究提供可行洞见。我们的工作弥合了理解编程语境下开发者-AI交互复杂性的重要空白，并为未来以开发者为中心的研究方向指明道路。
问题挑战: AI正重塑软件工程实践，但开发者-AI交互的多维特性（隐含意图、情感与具体行动如何交织）仍缺乏深入探索，先前研究仅关注可观察的活动维度。
核心方法: 对76名开发者开展混合方法研究，分AI辅助与非AI两组执行编程任务，从屏幕录像回溯标注意图、行动与情感并辅以问卷访谈，建立S-IASE四维（意图-行动-支持工具-情感）编程行为模型。
主要效果: 揭示AI辅助开发者更聚焦主动创建、评估与验证代码且情感流更稳定等模式，发现依赖AI引发的冒名顶替感，为AI助手设计与开发者培训提供可行洞见。
一句话总结: 针对开发者-AI交互行为维度建模缺失的问题，研究混合方法行为标注与建模技术，实现S-IASE四维行为模型并揭示AI协作的行为与情感模式。
关键词: 人机交互；AI辅助编程；行为建模；开发者研究；情感分析
作者团队简介: 通讯作者Bowen Xu，美国北卡罗来纳州立大学，研究方向为软件工程与开发者行为研究。

标题: From Specifications to Implementation in the Gen-AI Era: Lessons from a Project-based Software Engineering Course
标题翻译: 生成式AI时代从规格说明到实现：基于项目的软件工程课程经验
作者列表: Yingying Wang, Masih Beigi Rizi, Fatemeh Khashei, Julia Rubin
单位: Yingying Wang (University of British Columbia); Masih Beigi Rizi (University of British Columbia, Canada); Fatemeh Khashei (University of British Columbia); Julia Rubin (The University of British Columbia, Canada)
摘要: This paper investigates experiences, educational needs, and approaches for integrating Generative AI tools in an upper-level project-based undergraduate course on Software Engineering. We report on our course setup, our analysis of students’ experience in the last offering of the course, and an independent case study that we conducted to identify strengths, weaknesses, and strategies for using IDE-embedded AI tools, specifically GitHub Copilot and Cursor, when implementing a project equivalent in size and complexity to those typically carried out by the students in the course. Our results show that students utilize AI tools in all stages of project development: from requirements, through design, to implementation, testing, and code review, to generate and refine artifacts and to learn unfamiliar concepts. Students have mixed levels of satisfaction with using the tools, both as chat interfaces and as IDE-embedded solutions. We found no correlation between the degree of students’ reliance on AI and their grades. While Generative AI tools simplify repetitive development tasks and help quickly ramp up when working with unfamiliar frameworks and programming languages, these tools are still far from replacing software engineers or rendering software engineering education unnecessary. In fact, in the new AI-empowered reality, skills such as requirements engineering, design, code review, and systematic testing become more relevant than ever. We conclude the paper with a set of suggestions for future offerings of this and similar Software Engineering courses and for using AI in Software Engineering more broadly. We see a promising future for AI-empowered Software Engineering, where humans lead creative work and AI manages repetitive implementation tasks and programming language nuances.
摘要翻译: 本文研究在高年级项目制软件工程本科课程中整合生成式AI工具的经验、教育需求与方法。我们报告课程设置、对最近一期课程学生体验的分析，以及一项独立案例研究——识别使用IDE内嵌AI工具（特别是GitHub Copilot与Cursor）实现与学生课程项目规模与复杂度相当的项目时的优势、劣势与策略。结果表明，学生在项目开发全阶段使用AI工具：从需求、设计到实现、测试与代码评审，以生成与精炼制品并学习陌生概念。学生对工具（无论聊天界面还是IDE内嵌方案）的满意度不一。我们发现学生对AI的依赖程度与其成绩之间无相关性。尽管生成式AI简化了重复性开发任务，并帮助快速掌握陌生的框架与编程语言，但这些工具远不能取代软件工程师或使软件工程教育变得多余。事实上，在AI赋能的新现实中，需求工程、设计、代码评审与系统化测试等技能比以往任何时候都更为相关。我们以对该课程及类似软件工程课程未来开设的建议、以及对更广泛地在软件工程中使用AI的建议作结。我们看到AI赋能软件工程的美好前景：人类主导创造性工作，AI处理重复性实现任务与编程语言细节。
问题挑战: 生成式AI工具正重塑软件开发流程，但学生在项目制软件工程课程中如何使用IDE内嵌AI工具（Copilot、Cursor）、体验与效果如何，尚缺乏深入研究。
核心方法: 通过分析课程最近一期学生体验并开展独立案例研究，系统考察学生从需求、设计到实现、测试与代码评审各阶段使用AI工具的方式、满意度与策略。
主要效果: 发现学生在开发全流程使用AI工具但满意度不一，AI依赖程度与成绩无相关性；需求工程、设计、代码评审与系统化测试等技能在AI时代愈发重要。
一句话总结: 针对生成式AI融入软件工程教学经验不明的问题，研究课程实证与案例分析方法，为AI时代的软件工程教育提出系统性建议。
关键词: 软件工程教育；生成式AI；人机协作；AI辅助编程；教学改革
